4. The contention of learned counsels for the contesting parties is that after filing a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No.5583 of 2023 in re:Vaseem @ Mohammad Vaseem And Others vs. State of U.P. and Another, the parties had entered into a compromise vide compromise deed dated 15.04.2023, which had been brought on record of the aforesaid case on the basis of which this Court vide order dated 31.05.2023, a copy of which is filed as annexure No. SA-1 to the supplementary affidavit dated 22.09.2023, had required the aforesaid compromise to be verified by the learned court.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is contended that the learned court vide order dated 26.06.2023, a copy of which is filed as annexure SA-2 to the supplementary affidavit, has verified the said compromise.
It is further contended that in terms of the said compromise the entire proceedings of the aforesaid complaint case be quashed.

5. Considering the order of this Court dated 31.05.2023 as well as the compromise deed dated 15.04.2023, which has been duly verified by the learned court vide order dated 26.06.2023, and that the learned counsels for the contesting parties state that no further dispute subsists between the parties, the present petition is allowed.

The entire criminal proceedings of Case No.1796/12/2015 in Re: Smt. Kismatul Vs. Vaseem & Others, under Sections 498-A, 323, 376 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Fakharpur, District Bahraich, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Bahraich as well as summoning order dated 02.01.2023 passed by the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Bahraich are quashed.
